 def move(pos,speed=.04,settle=8):
  result=p['move_tip'](pos,quat,speed=speed,settle=settle)
  if result['ik_failures']: raise RuntimeError(result)
  return result
 print('initial',s.tip_pose(),flush=True)
 move([-.100,.150,.065],speed=.06)

 move([-.100,.150,.055],speed=.025)

 for i,path in enumerate(paths):
  pts=np.array(path,float)
  d=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(pts,axis=0),axis=1))]

  pts=np.array([np.interp(ticks,d,pts[:,k]) for k in range(2)]).T
  def pos(uv,z):return [*s.geo.px_to_world(*uv),z]

  Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(OUT/'canvas.png')
